units.title: SG-7 Story Panel and Round status UI with real API integration
Act: Add sceneTitle and scroll styling to StoryPanel
Act: Add onRetry and Retry button to HeaderOverlay error state
Act: Add describeRoundError, empty mapping and retry to App
Verify: StoryPanel scene title, scroll and choice unit tests

tests.id: storyPanelTitle.test.tsx::shows the scene title as the heading
tests.name: StoryPanel scene title and choices > shows the scene title as the heading
tests.title: shows the scene title as the heading
tests.scenario: Given StoryPanel with sceneTitle 'The Boys Room', When rendered, Then a level-1 heading with that text is present

tests.id: storyPanelTitle.test.tsx::lists both history entries in the Story history list
tests.name: StoryPanel scene title and choices > lists both history entries in the Story history list
tests.title: lists both history entries in the Story history list
tests.scenario: Given history ['a','b'], When rendered, Then the 'Story history' list has 2 list items

tests.id: storyPanelTitle.test.tsx::shows the inventory item inside the Inventory region
tests.name: StoryPanel scene title and choices > shows the inventory item inside the Inventory region
tests.title: shows the inventory item inside the Inventory region
tests.scenario: Given inventory ['key'], When rendered, Then the 'Inventory' region contains 'key'

tests.id: storyPanelTitle.test.tsx::keeps the panel root scrollable with the overflow-y-auto class
tests.name: StoryPanel scene title and choices > keeps the panel root scrollable with the overflow-y-auto class
tests.title: keeps the panel root scrollable with the overflow-y-auto class
tests.scenario: Given StoryPanel is rendered, When inspecting its root element, Then it has the overflow-y-auto class

tests.id: storyPanelTitle.test.tsx::calls onChoose with 1 when the second choice is clicked
tests.name: StoryPanel scene title and choices > calls onChoose with 1 when the second choice is clicked
tests.title: calls onChoose with 1 when the second choice is clicked
tests.scenario: Given a two-choice DialogueNode, When the second choice button is clicked, Then onChoose is called once with 1

units.title: Verify: HeaderOverlay Retry and success state unit tests

tests.id: headerRetry.test.tsx::calls onRetry exactly once when the Retry button is clicked in the error state
tests.name: HeaderOverlay retry and success states > calls onRetry exactly once when the Retry button is clicked in the error state
tests.title: calls onRetry exactly once when the Retry button is clicked in the error state
tests.scenario: Given the round request failed with error 'Round service returned 500' and onRetry is provided; When the player clicks Retry; Then onRetry is called once

tests.id: headerRetry.test.tsx::shows the round id, OPEN status and a timer with no Retry button when the round loads
tests.name: HeaderOverlay retry and success states > shows the round id, OPEN status and a timer with no Retry button when the round loads
tests.title: shows the round id, OPEN status and a timer with no Retry button when the round loads
tests.scenario: Given the round loaded successfully (roundFixture) and there is no error; Then no Retry button is shown, 'round-1' and 'OPEN' are visible, and a role=timer element is present

units.title: Verify: App round loading, empty, error and retry unit tests

tests.name: App round states: pending request shows loading
tests.title: Shows 'Loading round…' while the round request is pending
tests.scenario: Given the round request is pending, when the player begins, then the header shows the loading message

tests.name: App round states: loaded round shows id and status
tests.title: Shows the round id and OPEN status when the round loads
tests.scenario: Given the round loads, when the player begins, then the header shows the round id and OPEN status

tests.name: App round states: 404 shows no active round without alert
tests.title: Shows 'No active round' and no alert when the server answers 404
tests.scenario: Given the server answers 404, when the player begins, then the header shows 'No active round' and no alert

tests.name: App round states: 500 shows round service alert
tests.title: Shows an alert reporting 'Round service returned 500' on a 500 response
tests.scenario: Given the server answers 500, when the player begins, then an alert reports the round service status

tests.name: App round states: TypeError shows could-not-reach alert
tests.title: Shows an alert saying the server could not be reached on a TypeError
tests.scenario: Given the server cannot be reached, when the player begins, then an alert says the server could not be reached

tests.name: App round states: Retry loads the round after a failure
tests.title: Loads the round when Retry succeeds after a failed request, requesting the round twice
tests.scenario: Given the first request failed, when the player clicks Retry and the next request succeeds, then the round appears and the round was requested twice

tests.name: describeRoundError: ApiError with detail
tests.title: Includes the server detail in the message for an ApiError with detail
tests.scenario: Given an ApiError with a server detail, then the message includes the status and the detail

tests.name: describeRoundError: ApiError without detail
tests.title: Shows only the status for an ApiError without detail
tests.scenario: Given an ApiError without a server detail, then the message contains only the status

tests.name: describeRoundError: TypeError
tests.title: Says the server could not be reached for a TypeError
tests.scenario: Given a TypeError, then the message says the server could not be reached

tests.name: describeRoundError: plain string
tests.title: Falls back to the generic failure message for a plain string
tests.scenario: Given a plain string, then the message is the generic round request failure

units.title: REQ · Story Panel shows scene title and scrolls independently in pixel-art styling
REQ · Header explains round failure and offers Retry
REQ · App loads the round from the Go API with explained errors, empty state and retry
